snippets.snippet_text: "I bought a yearly subscription (finishing January 31st 2026) for $227.05 to a content provider called Chasing Bourbon. Patreon decided to take this content provider off their platform for their own decision/policy and now they refuse to reimburse me for the unused portion or $75.63. I happened to know the content provider and they are not paying him either so Patreon is just keeping my money. I want my money back since they are not providing the service that they terminated at their own decision"

possible_subjects: Patreon refund policy on platform-terminated creator (November 2025): buyer paid $227.05 annual subscription; Patreon removed creator and refused $75.63 pro-rated refund for unused portion
